C1543.title: Balancer Protocol Deflationary Token Vulnerability
C1543.summary: The Balancer protocol mishandled deflationary tokens, allowing an attacker to exploit the vulnerability and resulting in a loss of approximately $520,000. Since its launch in 2020, Balancer has encountered multiple similar security incidents, with the earliest dating back to early deflationary token exploits.
